meta.name: South African offshore wind profiles, per unit
meta.source: Renewables.ninja / MERRA-2. Wind: Vestas V164 8000 at 150 m. Same source, method and years as profiles_regional_multiyear.json, so offshore and onshore profiles are directly comparable - which is the point, because the claim being tested is that offshore is less variable than onshore.
meta.regions: The seven candidate offshore development regions identified in World Bank Group 2026, A Strategic Framework for Offshore Wind Development in South Africa, ESMAP. CC BY 3.0 IGO per the report's own rights page (the ESMAP landing page says CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO; the report governs).
meta.coordinate_warning: Centroids estimated from ESMAP prose, NOT from its Table 13. Replace if the table becomes available.
meta.turbine_note: Vestas V164 8000 is a CHOICE. A 15 MW-class machine would give a higher capacity factor and a flatter profile. The onshore profiles use a Vestas V90 2000 at 80 m, a REIPPPP-era onshore machine, so turbine and hub height both differ by design.
meta.encoding: per unit x 1000, integer. Leap days dropped so every year is 8760 h.

Boegoebaai West Coast.esmap_description: over 13,000 km2 west of Port Nolloth and the proposed Port of Boegoebaai; mean wind 9.2-9.7 m/s; 75-500 m; ~40 GW floating

Saldanha Bay West Coast.esmap_description: over 8,600 km2 northwest of Saldanha Bay; mean wind ~8.8 m/s; 0-500 m; 24 GW floating plus 1.4 GW fixed

Cape Point West.esmap_description: 1,282 km2 west of Cape Point; mean wind 9.9-10.6 m/s; 75-500 m

Cape Point South.esmap_description: 932 km2 south of Cape Point; mean wind 9.9-10.6 m/s; 75-500 m

Coega West.esmap_description: 1,365 km2 west of the Port of Ngqura; mean wind ~9 m/s; ~750 MW fixed plus over 3 GW floating

Coega East.esmap_description: 537 km2 east of the Port of Ngqura; mean wind ~9 m/s; ~550 MW fixed plus ~1 GW floating

Durban Richards Bay.esmap_description: nearly 2,900 km2 between the Port of Durban and Port of Richards Bay; mean wind ~9.4 m/s; over 17 GW floating
